name: Hiiro no Kakera Shin Tamayorihime Denshou -Piece of Future-
original_name: ヒイロノカケラ 新玉依姫伝承 -Piece of Future-
source:
The fandisc to Hiiro no Kakera Shin Tamayorihime Densetsu. Features 3 scenarios for each guardian with additional routes for the Suwa brothers and takes place after the ending of the last game.

[edited from [url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2011/10/20/otome-game-review-hiiro-no-kakera-piece-of-future/]Hinano's post[/url]]
translation:
《日色碎片新玉依姫传说》同人光盘。每个守护者有3个场景，诹访兄弟有额外的路线，发生在上一场游戏结束后。

[编辑自[url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2011/10/20/otome-game-review-hiiro-no-kakera-piece-of-future/]Hinano的帖子[/url]]
